subject: Remediation snapshot + signed attestation for SIG submission
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightspark.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@brightspark.ai
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remediation snapshot for SIG / CAIQ submission

Jordan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. BrightSpark is preparing our SIG/CAIQ package and the assessor has asked for a short remediation snapshot showing the delta between last external scan and current state, plus attestations for critical CVE closures (last 90 days). Specifically we need:

- A CSV of current open findings and their status (scan id + remediation owner + ETA)
- A short PDF that lists critical/high CVEs closed in the last 90 days with dates and PR/patch references
- A signed attestation from Redwood security saying you’ve completed the stated closures and the cadence you run vulnerability scans on production assets

Can you provide these items by end-of-day Wednesday (10/8)? Our assessor flagged this as a gating item for SIG review.

Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Security Program Manager, BrightSpark Analytics
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightspark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation snapshot for SIG / CAIQ submission

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can absolutely provide a remediation snapshot and a signed attestation. Looping in Marissa (Security) to assemble the closure notes and Grace (Engineering) to pull the scan export and confirm dates.

Proposed deliverables and timing:
- CSV of findings (filtered for production assets): Grace will export by tomorrow EOD (10/7)
- CVE closure PDF: Marissa will draft a short list with links to PRs/patches by 10/7 morning
- Signed attestation: I will sign and return by 10/7 afternoon once Marissa confirms wording

If BrightSpark needs the attestation in a specific format for SIG (DocuSign or company letterhead), let us know and we’ll do that.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightspark.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation snapshot for SIG / CAIQ submission

Hi Elena and team —

Quick status: I reviewed the triage logs and pulled the CVEs that closed in the last 90 days. I’ll attach a concise PDF with the following per-item fields: CVE ID, severity, first reported (scan), date patched, PR/CL link, responsible engineer.

Note on scope: the assessor asked for production asset coverage — we’ve limited the snapshot to the production clusters and the public-facing orchestration plane. If you need agent/endpoint telemetry too, call that out and we’ll expand the export.

Also adding our cadence statement here so it’s explicit in the attestation:
- External authenticated scan (third-party) run: monthly
- Internal authenticated scan: weekly for high-velocity services; full internal run: bi-weekly
- Triage SLA: critical (fix or mitigation) within 7 days; high within 30 days

I’ll attach the PDF and the CSV export in a follow-up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@brightspark.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation snapshot for SIG / CAIQ submission

Elena —

Attached are: bs-vm-snapshot-20251006.csv (filtered export of production scan findings) and cve-closure-notes-20251007.pdf (short list of critical/high CVEs closed in the last 90 days with PR links). A couple of implementation notes:

- The CSV includes columns: scan_id, asset_hostname, cve_id, severity, status, remediation_owner, remediation_ticket (JIRA-VM-####), target_fix_date
- For CVEs marked closed, we include the PR or merge commit hash and the deployment date into production
- One open critical (CVE-2025-3347) is in mitigation (WAF rule + temporary image pin); remediation target 2025-10-14. It is included in the CSV with status=mitigated and a remediation_ticket of JIRA-VM-4782

Attachments:
- bs-vm-snapshot-20251006.csv (type: text/csv)
- cve-closure-notes-20251007.pdf (type: application/pdf)

Let me know if you want the CSV anonymized or with additional context columns.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Staff SWE, Infra Reliability
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@brightspark.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remediation snapshot for SIG / CAIQ submission

Elena —

Attached is our attestation document (redwood-sig-attestation-20251007.pdf). In summary:

- Redwood confirms the CSV and closure notes accurately reflect the scan export for production assets dated 2025-10-06
- We confirm the scan cadence described below:
  • External third-party scans: monthly
  • Internal authenticated scans: weekly (targeted) and bi-weekly (full)
  • Triage SLA for critical CVEs: 7 days; high: 30 days
- The items listed as closed in cve-closure-notes-20251007.pdf were validated against merge commits/PRs and deployment timestamps; mitigation for CVE-2025-3347 is documented and tracked in JIRA-VM-4782

If you need the attestation on BrightSpark letterhead or DocuSign, say the word and I’ll route it through our legal ops for signature. Otherwise this PDF is signed by Redwood Security leadership and suitable for SIG submission.

Jordan
